message: JavaScript source analysis reached its 300000ms per-source server/provider deadline (analysis_timeout_ms), not the MCP client deadline.

remediation.action: Reuse accessible partial_observation Evidence to avoid recomputation; reading it is not a prerequisite for a corrected retry. Increase analysis_timeout_ms on the next call. Alternatively, reduce semantic limits or select exact inventoried source_paths. Omit source_paths to analyze all sources; an empty array is invalid. detail: summary reduces response size, not analysis work. Allow execution, cleanup and delivery headroom in the MCP client tool deadline; increasing that client deadline alone does not change this server budget. Resolve any reported incomplete cleanup before retrying.
